source_text: The first trial, in Kisumu, Kenya (ANRS 1265), enrolled 2,784 HIV-negative men aged 18-24 and found a 60% reduction in HIV incidence over 24 months in the circumcised group compared to controls (hazard ratio 0.40; 95% CI 0.24-0.68). [96]
